name: ICDAR 2015 Incidental Scene Text Benchmark
description: A classic scene text reading benchmark organized by the Computer Vision Center (CVC) at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona for ICDAR 2015 Challenge 4. Features 1,500 images captured incidentally without explicit focus, centering, or orientation using Google Glass wearable devices. Includes 1,000 training and 500 test images annotated with word-level quadrilateral bounding boxes and character transcriptions across extreme viewpoints and motion blur.
